name.description: Name is the unique name of the flag set.

sources.description: Sources are names of manifest objects of kind flags; a later source wins on a duplicate flag key.

segmentSources.description:
SegmentSources are names of manifest objects of kind segments; the segments that the rules of this flag set
name with segment("name") are defined there. A name must be defined once in all the sources of a flag set.

apiKeys.description: APIKeys are plain inline keys (UUIDs). They are secrets: never log them.

FlagSet.description: FlagSet binds flag objects and API keys.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the document version, "semaphore/v1". Empty means the current version when marshalling.

kind.description: Kind is "FlagSet". Empty means "FlagSet" when marshalling.

FlagSetDocument.description: FlagSetDocument is the document of kind FlagSet.
